note: Ground truth meaning of each capability. A tool (or tool+action) provides exactly one capability.

capabilities.room.search: Find rooms that are free for a time window and match criteria (capacity, equipment, floor). Read-only. No specific room known yet.
capabilities.room.get: Facts about ONE known room: capacity, equipment, floor, accessibility, location. Read-only.
capabilities.room.hold: Temporary, auto-expiring hold (about 15 minutes) on a known room and slot. Not a confirmed booking; no invites.
capabilities.booking.create: Confirmed reservation of a known room and slot, with calendar invites. Binding.
capabilities.ticket.create: Open a NEW maintenance request for a fault that is not yet ticketed.
capabilities.ticket.list_open: List unresolved maintenance tickets (filter by building/status). Read-only.
capabilities.ticket.log: Append a work note / labour minutes to an EXISTING ticket id.
capabilities.asset.lookup: Facts about one tagged asset: warranty, service dates, condition, install location.
capabilities.vendor.lookup: Facts about approved vendors: trade, contact, emergency line, insurance expiry.
capabilities.badge.grant: Grant physical access (zones, date range) to a person - employee, hire or contractor.
